dialect.detail: IBM mainframe batch COBOL; uses RECORDING MODE IS F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, COMP-3, INDEXED file with FILE STATUS, COPY statements for copybooks (ELCDTEFD, ERCREIN), sequence numbers in columns 1-6 and 73-80, fixed format. Likely compiled under IBM VS COBOL II or COBOL for MVS/OS.
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED / FILE STATUS / RECORD KEY
ASSIGN TO SYS010 / SYS015 / ERREIN style DDNAMEs

purpose.domain_detail: Reinsurance reporting — selects and prints lines from ECS-045 microfiche reports for specific reinsurance company codes; program CIRE010 is part of an insurance reinsurance reporting system with a year-end variant CIRE010Y
purpose.summary: Batch program that reads an ECS-045 microfiche input file and a reinsurance indexed file, selects print lines for specific reinsurance company codes (maintained in an internal table of ~104 entries), and writes output to one or two report files. The program has been actively maintained since 1991 with a detailed change log tracking additions and removals of company codes.

notable_features: Large internal company-code table (OCCURS 104 TIMES) with HIGH-VALUES sentinel
INDEXED file with FILE STATUS and RECORD KEY (REINSURANCE-FILE)
COMP-3 field (S0C7 — likely used for numeric trap)
Extensive change log with dated change markers in sequence-number area
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full PROCEDURE DIVISION not visible but mechanical indicators show 19 PERFORMs, 7 GOTOs, 181 PIC clauses — consistent with a substantial production batch program. The sequence numbers in columns 73-80 and the change-log markers in columns 1-6 are characteristic of IBM mainframe source management (e.g. PANVALET or LIBRARIAN).
